ooe_rcu_issue_payload.lead_opcode.why: DA rev 116 (13 RCU / 0 OOE, re:RI-26): OOE's side of the zero-cycle issue end's lead_opcode is wire only, straight from ooe_rs's issue register's lead slice (iss_lead_cq03h, required 0.0 in ooe_rs.ngd.json), so RCU's in-side takes 13 (0 + 13 <= 25). Every slot; every other lead field and the payload keep the port's budget.
